title: Grocery tools to explore
intro: Soft CTAs for established supermarket, delivery and meal patterns when you are modelling which fit matches your household. Confirm coverage, hours and offers on each site — this block is not a ranking of chains.

items.reason: Full-service supermarket benchmark — useful when modelling a one-stop weekly basket or AH Bezorgen as a delivery option.
App-based grocery delivery — check postcode coverage when a time-poor or delivery-led week is one of your fit priorities.
Meal kits for predictable dinner costs — compare per-serving price with store-brand cooking before treating it as a supermarket replacement.

disclosure: Some links may be affiliate or referral links. If you use them, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Ordering reflects page relevance for choice modelling, not pay-to-rank placement or an awards podium. Food prices and coverage change — treat any basket as orientation, not a quote. This is not financial advice.
